q.en: "He was found guilty and received a criminal ___."
q.bn: "He was found guilty and received a criminal ___."

why.en: "Conviction" is the noun form, needed here after "a criminal".
why.bn: "Conviction" noun form, "a criminal"-এর পরে এটাই লাগবে।

q.en: "Supporters argue that harsh sentences act as a ___ to crime."
q.bn: "Supporters argue that harsh sentences act as a ___ to crime."

why.en: A "deterrent" is something that discourages an action — harsh sentences are argued to deter crime.
why.bn: "Deterrent" মানে এমন কিছু যা একটা কাজ করা থেকে বিরত রাখে — harsh sentences crime deter করে বলে argument দেওয়া হয়।

q.en: Which pair contrasts minor offences with serious offences involving harm?
q.bn: কোন pair minor offence আর harm জড়িত serious offence-এর মধ্যে contrast দেখায়?

why.en: "Petty crime" refers to minor offences like theft, while "violent crime" involves serious harm.
why.bn: "Petty crime" মানে theft-এর মতো minor offence, আর "violent crime"-এ serious harm জড়িত থাকে।

q.en: "Education programmes in prisons have been shown to reduce ___."
q.bn: "Education programmes in prisons have been shown to reduce ___."

why.en: "Recidivism" is the tendency of a convicted criminal to reoffend — education programmes aim to reduce it.
why.bn: "Recidivism" মানে একজন convicted criminal-এর আবার crime করার প্রবণতা — education programme এটা কমানোর চেষ্টা করে।

q.en: Which approach focuses on helping an offender reform and reintegrate into society?
q.bn: কোন approach একজন offender-কে reform করে society-তে reintegrate করতে সাহায্য করায় focus করে?

why.en: "Rehabilitation" focuses on education, community service, and helping offenders reintegrate into society.
why.bn: "Rehabilitation" education, community service, এবং offender-কে society-তে reintegrate করায় focus করে।
